rules.name: rrr-config-check
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) ORDER BY business_unit, updated_timestamp DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT value_date, settlement_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.vdate_sdate_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) AND value_date BETWEEN :since AND :valueDate + 7 GROUP BY value_date, settlement_date ORDER BY value_date

SELECT business_unit, tablename, valuation_date, status_type, status, created_by, created_timestamp FROM opera.status_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) AND tablename LIKE 'client_statement_cache_table%' ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, MIN(created_timestamp) AS first_written, MAX(created_timestamp) AS last_written FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) AND value_date >= :since GROUP BY business_unit, value_date, settlement_date ORDER BY business_unit, value_date

WITH ten AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) SELECT 'security_settle_price at value date' AS source, business_unit, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND value_date = :valueDate GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'latest_active_lot non zero (current)', business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND active_lots <> 0 GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'cash balance at settlement date', business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND cob_date = :cob GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'grasa 10d pie at settlement date', business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM opera.grasa_10dpie_rrr_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND cob_date = :cob GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'dripping at value date', business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM opera.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND value_date = :valueDate GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'rrr_report at settlement date', business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM opera.rrr_report_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND cob_date = :cob GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'rrr_report at previous settlement date', business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM opera.rrr_report_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND cob_date = :prevCob GROUP BY business_unit ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT value_date, settlement_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) AND value_date BETWEEN :since AND :valueDate + 7 GROUP BY value_date, settlement_date ORDER BY value_date

SELECT business_unit, threshold_def_ageing_buffer, cash_def_ageing_buffer, client_cash_call_buffer, account_balance_buffer, ofi_internal_threshold, ofi_external_threshold, ofi_total_threshold, ogh_internal_threshold, ogh_external_threshold, ogh_total_threshold FROM opera.rrr_report_configuration WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :tenantBu LIMIT 1) ORDER BY business_unit
SELECT 'cfs and orm' AS tables_used, value_date, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table
SELECT 'rmc' AS tables_used, value_date, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table_rmc
